d: Short, ash-brown hair with straight bangs and a soft texture frames a youthful face with wide, bright lime-green eyes. The build is slender and petite. The outfit consists of a white collared shirt tucked into a short black skirt, layered with an open tan cardigan, black fingerless gloves, one black thigh-high stocking with a grey armored knee guard, and black lace-up combat boots. A large, ornate futuristic staff with blue glowing accents and silver metallic plating is held in both hands.
